articleTitle: Research on the improvement of multicast Ad Hoc On-demand Distance Vector in MANETS
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Tree-based multicast routing provides fast and most efficient way of routing establishment for the communications of mobile nodes in wireless Ad Hoc networks. MAODV (Multicast Ad Hoc On-demand Distance Vector) is one commonly known tree-based multicast routing protocol, which has minimal control overhead and route acquisition latency. This paper presents a way to improve the throughput of the system and reduce the number of mobile nodes participating in multicast routing algorithms, which will significantly reduce the routing-related control overhead. A systematic performance evaluation is done by performing certain simulations under NS-2.The applicability of these protocols to diverse situation are also studied and discussed.

articleTitle: Reflections of training the creative and entrepreneurial talents by means of the simulation environment on campus
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Campus simulation and integrated internship have become the key experimental projects researched and propagandized by experimental teaching demonstration centers of economics and management colleges and universities. This paper, based on the comprehensive analysis of the successful experience and existed shortcomings of China's 16 university experimental centers, has discussed the strategies to scientifically construct the integrated training environment with society simulation as well as strategies to propel the reform of the training mode of creative and entrepreneurial talents. This paper believes that in order to effectively implement the simulation internship on campus, experts' participation should be fully considered, society emulation should be the dominant operating mechanism of the simulation and introduced to the routine teaching, network information technology applications should be intensified, and a sound operational mechanism should be built.

articleTitle: Validating clusterings of gene expression data
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: We propose a measure for the validation of clusterings of gene expression data. This measuse also useful to estimate missing gene expression levels, based the similarity information contained in a given clustering. It is shown that this measure is an improvement over the figure of merit, an existing validation measure especially vedloped for clusterings of gene expression data.

articleTitle: Printed character recognition using Kernel CCA with LS-SVM method
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: As an improved unsupervised learning algorithm of CCA, Kernel Canonical Correlation Analysis (Kernel CCA) can extend CCA to the nonlinear case by applying the kernel trick. In this paper, an optical character recognition system based on image preprocessing technologies combined with Kernel CCA has been developed. Moreover, due to the duality between Kernel CCA and LS-SVM, the optimization problem of Kernel CCA is transformed into the solving of quadratic equations by means of LS-SVM method. The proposed method has been evaluated by carrying out recognition experiments on the optical printed characters of electronic components. The results show that the proposed method has a better recognition performance, and the computational complexity can be simplified largely by introducing LS-SVM method.

articleTitle: Marine propulsion systems and the influence of the operational fators
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: This paper represents a step forward toward the introduction of engineering advanced research methods for the study of dynamic behavior of marine propulsion systems. The large dimensions of this work and its both theoretical and research material developed in it via numerical simulation are witnessing of the author effort for an exhaustive treatment of the proposed theme.

articleTitle: Computer technology application in sediment facies study
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: The study of sedimentary facies is one of main segments of fine reservoir description. With the development of computer technology, it becomes possible for geologists to study sediment facies from point of single well to surface and even to three-dimension. Here we give an example of a carbonate reservoir oil field. First, we begin the study with seismic facies by artificial neural network. Then according to lithology character of well logs and sediment knowledge, well log facies have been built. Finally combined seismic data and well log data, a three-dimensional sediment facies model has been built. On the basis of the facies model, reservoir properties can be well described and the reservoir distribution can be clearly showed which have made reservoir prediction more efficient and more credible.

articleTitle: Recursive symbolic bound analysis in loop structure
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach to symbolic bound analysis in loop structure. Our method is precise to analyze nonlinear correlated induction variables in the multi-loop and multi-branch programs by structure analysis with solutions of symbolic equations and inequalities. Based on the symbolic operation, the bounds of induction variables with analytical algebraic representations could be solved. This method performs effectively at the analysis of the symbolic (also numeric) bounds of array indices, pointers and other complicate variables in loop structures. Experimental results from our prototype implementation indicate that this technology could be used in practical detections to solve those bound problems.

articleTitle: Application of distributed safe log management in Small-Scale, High-Risk system
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: We described an implementation of log managing structure to store log in a Small-Scale, High-Risk distributed environment, which protects the integrity for log even some of storage nodes fail and guarantees the security in the case of secret log divulgence, meanwhile will not cause large space consumption. After collecting log from agents, Collect Center disperses log into pieces using Rabin's Information Dispersal Algorithm (IDA), builds Distributed Fingerprint (DFP) for integrity check. Integrity though the structure gets, it is still not safe enough to avoid the divulgence of secret log in the process of log dispersal and retrieval, some cryptography technology is applied into the log management.

articleTitle: Learning management system with personalized recommendation based on agent BDI
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Be aimed at solve the problem of insufficiency of personalized recommendation function in the open and distance learning (ODL) information services, this article puts forward a learning management system with personalized recommendation function (RLMS) based on agent. A learner agent (LA) is set up, which substitutes an online learner, maintains and analyzes learners' actions and interest. A recommendation agent (RA) is also set up in the system. It recommends the learning resource for the learners, which fits their individual characteristics. Three intentions are set up for RA to express three kinds of recommendation logic. The description of learner's information model, learner's interests model, the matchmaking process, the definition of RA's intentions as well as actions, the recommendation algorithm are also discussed in this paper. Meanwhile, a prototype has been built to verify the validity and efficiency of the algorithm. The prototype system uses JADE as the design platform of agent and uses Lucene to serve retrieving of learning resources. Experiments based on real data showed that this mechanism can recommend learner learning resource properly and effective, and it has sustainable improved efficiency and scalability of collaborative learning for ODL learners.

articleTitle: Study on air formation attack-to-ground decision making based on rough set theory
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Air formation attack to ground campaign system has it's characteristics which different from the other campaign mode, and it's decision making system is different from the other too. As to characteristics of air formation attack to ground campaign, an air formation attack to ground command and decision making information system is presented. On the basis of rough set theory, this paper study and simulating on the way of getting decision rules and attribute reduction in air formation attack to ground perfect and imperfect decision information system, and extract the decision rules. We compare the imperfect rules to the perfect rules, and analyze the dependency of the rules. The dependable factor of imperfect rules getting from the imperfect information system is calculated, which can provide a support to decision-making in campaign.

articleTitle: Design and realization of an improved information hiding algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: To improve information hiding algorithm, an improved algorithm realizing digital image watermark embedding in the transform domain is presented. On the basis of deeply understanding that the coefficient of a digital image after Discrete wavelet transform has correlation, it carries out discrete cosine transform of the transformed digital image coefficient and then embeds digital watermarks, which makes the algorithm have the characteristics of the two transforms.Experiments showed that this algorithm not only ensures the invisibility of watermark but also has good robustness.

articleTitle: A redesign methodology for Reverse Engineering integrated with haptic modeling
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Product redesign has been the main focus of Reverse Engineering (RE), especially for freeform shapes. Research in product redesign has led to the development of some interactive and intuitive deformation methods for freeform curves and surfaces modification with traditional two-dimensional based human-computer interfaces. Haptic interface provides new ways for human to interact with objects in virtual world. In this paper, we propose a new redesign methodology for reverse engineering integrated with haptic modeling, which can fuse its intuitive and flexibility of haptic modeling into smoothness and precision of parametric RE.

articleTitle: Towards scalable video coding: A wavelet based error resilient Probabilistic approach
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Scalable video coder satisfies virtually any constraints imposed by several transmission, storage and display devices. Existing solutions and implementations of scalable coder scarifies performance in erroneous transmission conditions. There is a need to design and develop a coder that not only gracefully degrades the performance but also provide efficient error resilience against channel noise and attacks. Experimental results discussed in this paper demonstrate the error propagation through layered pyramidal coding and motivate the use of Probabilistic approach in motion estimation and need of new motion model for better error resilient solution. We also propose probabilistic motion estimation model for possibility of better error resilience video coding.

articleTitle: Applied Bayesian network to construct the adaptive personalized e-learning platform
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Library is always a good place when person need to survey abundant information. But how can it organize the plenty of textbooks, videos and all others kinds of documents to provide each reader to effectively find what they want. With the rapid development in ubiquitous computing and e-learning technology, people can easy to get all kinds of digital interactive contents by various mobile devices at any times no mater at any places. We combine the RFID technology and Mobile Agents to construct an M-Learning system of library. First, we combine our e-learning system and on-line testing platform to library management system. By the learning and testing records of students we can analysis individual preferences and current learning state of each student who came into our library. Then using the RFID to track the reader's visiting path in library and the books which are referenced by the reader, we can offer a suitable navigation suggestion to each reader to help them find effectively all similar relevant books or information which they want. Finally, through different functions of AP servers which record the latest dynamic reader's querying media of books and reading behaviors, our mobile agents can periodically collect these data to provide the recommending AP server with the intelligent guidance and the adaptive learning library environment.

articleTitle: Obstacle-climbing capability analysis of lunar rover based on double-half-revolution mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: The obstacle-climbing performance on uneven terrain was analyzed according to the characteristics of the lunar rover based on double-half-revolution mechanism. Because the obstacle-climbing model of uneven terrain was relatively complicated and the numbers of independent equation were less than those of unknown variables, a new evaluation index of the obstacle-climbing capability was presented. Pointed out that the larger the friction feasible region, the better the obstacle-climbing capability, and when the friction feasible region the wheel-leg suffered did not exist, the mechanism would not have the obstacle-climbing capability under the initial conditions. The obstacle-climbing force model under friction constraints was established when giving the slope angle and obstacle height, two wheel-legs and single wheel-leg forward obstacle-climbing capability were simulated through the method of finding the wheel-leg's friction feasible region. Simulation results show that the feasible solution regions of T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf>, T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>, T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> and T<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf> are affected by applying specific frictional coefficient.

articleTitle: A soft information calculating method for SC-FDE output symbol
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: The hard decision symbol of conventional SC-FDE output is not perfect to the posterior SISO decoder of Shannon limit codes such as Turbo code and LDPC codes, which can achieve the Shannon limit performance on condition that the in-out information is soft. In this paper, a soft information calculation method for SC-FDE output symbol is proposed which increases the accuracy of information into the SISO decoder of Shannon limit codes and improves the transmission system. The numerical simulation results also show that the soft output SC-FDE gains an advantage over the hard one and the additional SNR gain can be obtained in frequency selective channel.

articleTitle: Seafood-exporter logistics activities and services - an international cooperation between Taiwan and Vietnam
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Logistics activities consist of customer service, logistics communication and order processing, planning, purchasing, inventory management, warehousing and storage, transportation, forwarding, customs clearance, and reverse logistics. However, the logistics activities and services for seafood products are rarely discussed by Taiwanese and Vietnamese logistics providers. In this paper, different situations, relationships, and possible opportunities in the context of cooperation between Taiwan and Vietnam are discussed.

articleTitle: Port supply chain simulation based on system dynamics method
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Supply chain simulation has received great attention from most scholars in recent years. According to the deficiency of special supply chain's research, this paper works over the port supply chain simulation. A port supply chain dynamic simulation model is established, and then, based on that model, Simulink tools is adopted for simulation. Through the change of variables, some valuable viewpoints are brought forward. Firstly, port's capability limits have great influence on the operation of supply chain. Secondly, the investment on limits, especial the bottlenecks, can bring out large profits and the exact value can be calculated through the simulation. Thirdly, in the view of supply chain management, sometimes, an investment for the others maybe brings out great profits to a port itself. In this way, it's useful to evaluate some investment systematically and make a wise investment decision for the port enterprises.

articleTitle: Analysis and realization of spatial object positioning
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: One spatial object's location can be determined through analyzing the two pictures of the object, which are taken by two digital cameras. To this end, the coordinates of the object's characteristics points must be calculated in the pictures. Usually the target center is used, instead, as its characteristic point. The paper first utilizes image processing technique to determine the coordinate of the round of the target. Then the location of the center can be calculated with matrix transformation methods. Finally, this process is implemented in MATLAB language and the experimental results are accordant with the actual values in the scope of permissible error rate.

articleTitle: A study of influence factors affecting to cutting tool ware in cold work steels turning (DC53)
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: The purpose of this research was to study factors affecting the tool ware in cold work steels (DC53) turning using cutting tools with Physical Vapor Deposition (PVD) process. Factors studied set at three levels were consisted of cutting speeds, feed rates, and depth of cuts applying factorial design. Results revealed that interaction factor of cutting speeds, feed rates and depth of cuts was affected to tool ware of cold work steels turning significantly different at the level of .01. Moreover, the result showed that at low level of feed rate, high level of cutting speed and depth of cut would provide better tool life than middle level of feed rate, high level of high level of cutting speed and depth of cut.

articleTitle: Transition to a low-carbon energy system through cooperation between urban and rural areas: Case study of a model area in China
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: In order to copper with the continuing global warming, various innovative plans have been promoted by both the country and also the local levels. However, as the most important local elements, urban and rural areas are always examined in a separate way to find the way to the low-carbon society, especially the low-carbon energy system. In this study, an integrated energy system covering both urban and rural areas is promoted based on the concept of making full use of local natural resources. By using a plan and evaluation model, a case study is executed for the Huzhou city in Zhejiang province, China. According to the simulation results, with the cooperation between urban and rural areas, the CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions can be reduced in a cost-effective way even to 50% of current level. In addition, by endowing an economic value to the reduced CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions, not only the economic benefit of the total energy system is increased, the economic and environmental balance can be also realized between the urban and rural areas.

Author Keywords: cooperation between urban and rural areas

articleTitle: Neural network construction and its predication for coal-blending at coal combustion power station
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: With the coal consumption increasing gradually, coal blending is becoming a routine work in power stations. Due to the fluctuation of the coal quality, coal blending is in fact an optimization problem under uncertain conditions, so that it is difficult to solve with the traditional linear programming model. On the other hand, BP neural network, a nonlinear optimization tool, has been successfully applied to coal blending. In this paper, the prediction effects of different BP neural network model were analyzed and the main factors affecting the prediction effects were also studied. These factors included network structure, learning sample quantities, hidden nodes, learning accuracy and etc. Based on the above analyses and studies, BP neural networks were built to predict characteristics, such as low heat and others, of blended coals, and the prediction accuracy is extremely high. Three cases were predicted in this paper. In addition, the optimization of coal blending was conducted with exhaustive method, and it is very directive to the practical coal blending. The characteristics of neural network are with close relation with the data extension of the input and output samples, so it is universal and has strong expansion.

articleTitle: Design of a chaotic signature strategy
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: This paper designed a chaotic digital signature scheme, which used Hash function to improve the high-dimensional Arnold cat chaotic system. In the high-dimensional Arnold cat mapping modular arithmetic is used, and because that the role of modular arithmetic is to convert a large number into a certain value range, so it is very sensitive to low-level changes. In the improved Hash function the high bit and the low bit are exchanged to resolve the high bit non-sensitivity to modular arithmetic, so the security of Hash function can be improved.

articleTitle: Image fusion method considering region&texture feature
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: In this paper, a new multi-scale scheme for image fusion is presented using texture and edge information. The original images are decomposed into texture and edge maps by pyramid structures. The coefficients corresponding to the filtered texture and edge maps are solved by the singular value decomposition and the linear relationship between Gauss filter and Laws texture extract filter. The decomposed images are represented using the texture and edge features in each scale, and fused using fuzzy region based strategy. To evaluate the fusion results, an objective image fusion performance metrics are used. The experiment results demonstrate by several real image data that the proposed scheme can achieve better fusion performance than the traditional pyramid decomposition methods.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of school management service system
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: The campus management service system uses the Visual C++6.0 to design graphical interface, and encapsulate the products to ensure the confidentiality of technology. As the time of student to school and leave school is more focused, the instant messaging of the SMS is very large, so to use a variety of technologies to enhance the generation, processing, sending and receiving speed of the SMS, this system intends to use SQL Sever database storage process technology to complete the SMS generation, use Visual C++6.0 and JAVA multi-threading technology to achieve the development of client-side campus management service system and server-side SMS value-added service platform, to enhance the speed of sending and receiving SMS, prevent SMS clogging.

articleTitle: Routing optimization strategy using Genetic Algorithm utilizing bandwidth and delay
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Intelligent analysis and designing of network routing provides an edge in this increasingly fast era. In this work, we present a variation of Genetic Algorithm (GA) for finding the Optimized shortest path of the network. The algorithm finds the optimal path by using an objective function consisting of the bandwidth and delay metrics of the network. We also introduce the concept of ¿2-point over 1-point crossover¿. The population comprises of all chromosomes (feasible and infeasible). Moreover, it is of variable length, so that the algorithm can perform efficiently in all scenarios. Rank-based selection is used for cross-over operation. Mutation operation is used for maintaining the population diversity. We have also performed various experiments for the population selection. The experiments indicate that random selection method is the most optimum. Hence, the population is selected randomly once the generation is developed. The results prove our assertion that our proposed algorithm finds the optimal shortest path more efficiently than existing algorithms. In this work, we have shown the results using a smaller network; however the work for larger network is in progress.

articleTitle: A scene-aware adaptive media playout algorithm for wireless video streaming
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: This paper addresses the issue of buffer underflow in wireless multimedia service, due to both the unreliable and time-varying nature of the wireless channel. Specifically, we propose a statistical model to estimate the buffer underflow time. Based on the estimation of the underflow time, a scene-aware adaptive playout algorithm with dual-threshold to adjust the frame rate is presented. This approach adjusts the threshold dynamically according to the channel conditions and the status of the buffer, and thus regulates the frame rate timely. Moreover, the algorithm possesses scene-aware characteristics, since it adjusts the playout rate according to the motion intensity of the playout scenes to reduce the underflow probability of the buffer and provides better QoS. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme efficiently reduces the probability of the buffer underflow and provides better visual quality.

articleTitle: An non-slicing area prejudged algorithm for floorplanning without Simulated Annealing
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Existing floorplanning algorithms can not get the target area after random perturbation until packing complete, but random perturbation will make the target area larger or less unpredictably. In this paper, an unified non-slicing area prejudged(TCG-AP) algorithm is proposed which can estimate the target area after random perturbation without packing. The prejudged result can indicate whether the perturbation is beneficial to the target area, if isn't, we discard it and continue next permutation. This process always makes the target area less and less. Unlike most of the existing floorplanning algorithms, our algorithm is running without using SA(Simulated Annealing) process because of the convergence itself. The geometric relations among modules in our algorithm are horizontal/vertical transitive closure graphs based on TCG[1]. Inherited the nice properties from TCG, the solution space is finite(n!*n!) and every solution is feasible. The experimental results with MCNC and GSRC benchmarks, show that our algorithm is efficient and effective to get smaller area.

articleTitle: Energy-efficent time synchronization algorithm for wireless sensor networks
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: In wireless sensor networks, energy efficiency is an important standard for evaluating the effectiveness of the time synchronization protocols. Hence, energy should be conserved as much as possible provided that algorithm can achieve a certain accuracy. In this paper, we propose an energy efficient time synchronization algorithm in which each layer of the network can be synchronized merely by receiving broadcast messages rather than relying on two-way message exchange. Simulation results show that our improved strategy reduced the energy consumption and prolonged the lifetime of network compared with TPSN.

articleTitle: Fault isolation using stateless server model in L4 microkernel
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Existing system architecture model cannot guarantee isolation of applications or system components from system faults that occur in system services. If an error causes the failure by operating system services, the entire system can be corrupted or components which are dependent that services are affected. Fault tolerant architecture model can be achieved by decoupling state information from the server. In this paper, we compare four kinds of architecture models. For constructing stateless server model, we use simple lightweight middleware. It can support fault tolerant architecture with low performance overhead.

articleTitle: Method of software testing based on program understanding
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: The large scale software system requires computational management techniques in engineering designs, implementations and maintains urgently. This paper discusses an approach of program understanding with mathematical foundations for computation of software behavior. Computational analyses automatically figure out possible behavior and security attributes of software components both for source files and binary executes. The results of program understanding in formula and concurrent assignments forms augment human intelligence in program analysis, testing and evaluation. Program understanding transforms specification verification, software product and security attribute into computational procedure that would achieve intelligent management in next generation Software Engineering.

articleTitle: Interactive Learning Models based on extension intelligence
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: The paper describes interactive learning system (ILS) for intuition judgement and data abalysis. The selection of Interactive Learning Models is performed under both intuition and data analysis learning. and poses a skeleton of intuitive reasoning. Through the relationship construction of practical intuitive model and on-the-spot model, it sets up a couple of interactive learning models and intuitive information acquisition. The study shows that the premise of automatic reasoning is to set up patterns of intuitive sub-optimum relationship. The paper views that the reliability of the automatic reasoning depends on the man-computer interaction results. Simultaneously, choosing the case-cracking clue should be determined by comprehensive evaluations and self-learning of intuition or sub-optimum judgments are essentially needed. A simple example on how to create and apply the model is give. The presented model can be applied conveniently by selecting suitable ILS in accordance with the give intuitive judge and computing the best decision from the rules in those ILS.

articleTitle: Exploring the factors influencing success of supply chains in China: Towards development of a research model
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: This paper looks at factors influencing success of supply chains in China and develops a model of supply chain success. The proposed model has both theoretical and practical implications. It can be adapted for application in supply chain management practices in different contexts and environments.

articleTitle: The computer simulation for the hydraulic motor with planetary drive of bevel gear
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: this thesis presented a new kind of hydraulic motor with swing planetary drive of bevel gears, and researched the calculation of the efficiency of the mechanism. The main significant or the main difficulties are: firstly, this is a kind of planetary drive of mechanism with space gearing; secondly, the driving component is the planetary gear with special movement. This paper solved this new kind problem of efficient calculation.

articleTitle: Research on security authentication of hierarchy distributed Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: The characteristics of Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) determine that the traditional security authentication mechanism can not meet its security requirements. Starting from the analysis on existing WSN security authentication solution scheme and combing with the widely used hierarchy distributed WSN architecture, the paper referred to the idea of security authentication of PKI with digital certificate and brought out a kind of hierarchy distributed WSN security authentication mechanism. The certificate structure as well as identity and data origin authentication with certificate were designed. The update scheme of certificate and sharing keys was also provided.

articleTitle: Injected linguistic tags to improve phrase based SMT
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: This paper presents Injected Tags (ITs) approach, that improves the phrase based statistical machine translation (PBSMT) approach. This Injected Tags approach has been applied to ¿English into Arabic translation¿. This approach is language independent and can be used with any language pair. It has shown considerable improvement of the translation quality of at least 13% increase of BLEU score. The approach has been evaluated and has been compared with several online Machine Translation (MT) services. The experiments reveal that the results achieved by this approach considered significant enhancements over PBSMT.

articleTitle: Based on the fuzzy control of piezoelectric pump with built-in self test
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: This paper presents a pump built-in self test actuated by piezoelectric bimorphs for fluidic systems. The sensor fabricated by MEMS ensures the accuracy of measurement. The fuzzy control uses in the system. The fuzzy controller in the closed-loop with the flow sensor proved to be effective. The pump is characterized by integrated structure, flow with built-in self test, wide frequency response, etc. The size of the piezoelectric pump with built-in self test is not larger than 30 mm, which is fabricated by precise manufacturing. The high-speed micro processor is used to run the algorithmic program and control the pump with self test. Experiments show that the fuzzy sets and controller are fitted for the flow control system. With the appropriate fuzzy rules, the new type of piezoelectric pump can achieve the precision of 0.5 ¿ l/s.

articleTitle: An evolutionary approach for probabilistic temporal fuzzy controllers
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Temporal fuzzy systems are powerful systems that use temporal information in their reasoning process. Probabilistic fuzzy systems are the systems that combine the advantages of probabilistic and fuzzy uncertainty with each other. In this paper, we propose a novel approach, which combines the advantages of probabilistic fuzzy systems with temporal fuzzy systems. The proposed algorithm uses an evolutionary algorithm to find the parameters of the system. In order to examine the proposed method, a fuzzy controller for an overhead crane system is designed. Simulation results show that the proposed method has better performance than other methods.

articleTitle: Line detection Fusion using Spatial Frequency Measurement
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: In this paper, we present a line detection fusion method using Spatial Frequency Measurement (SFM). Our proposed method, A¿ trous algorithm is firstly applied with the original image to get the line feature detail information in two difference resolutions from a coarse one with 5×5 mask and a fine one with 3×3 mask. Next, both line feature detail information are fused to get a complete line feature using Spatial Frequency Measurement, which is compared with Laplacian Operator. From the experiments, we found that our proposed method provides a complete line feature evaluated by the correlation value. Also, the method is general and can be applied to other features in imagery.

articleTitle: Fuzzy optimization of plain linkage applying hybrid genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: In view of the design sample of crank-rocker linkage, considering the uncertainty of the design variable value and load-bearing capacity, and satisfying the Grashof condition and the transmission performances, the fuzzy optimization mathematic model is established to minimize the deviation between the desired and the calculated path law of motion. The method of second-class comprehensive evaluation was used by the optimal level cut set, thus the fuzzy optimization is transformed into the usual optimization. Considering the problem of low efficiency and local optimum caused by traditional optimal methods, the hybrid genetic algorithm are adopted to solve the optimization model. The results demonstrate that the fuzzy approach is an effective tool to deal with the uncertainties present in design optimization and can provide more realistic solutions. So that the optimization process is simplified and global optimum is acquired reliably.

articleTitle: Role-based workflow model in SRS
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: This paper puts forward a new the role-based workflow model which is applicable to the shipping industry. Firstly based on the characteristics of SRS, we obtain the RBAC relational diagram which is applicable to SRS. Then combined this diagram and the traditional role-based workflow model, the new model was put forward. At last, from the mathematics view we describe the model in detail.

articleTitle: Study on membrane protein interaction network based on ensemble intelligent method
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Membrane protein and its interaction network has become a novel research direction in bioinformatics. Multiple researches on these interactions can improve our understanding of diseases and provide the basis to revolutionize therapeutic treatments. In this paper, a novel membrane protein interaction network simulator is proposed for system biology studies by ensemble intelligent method including spectrum analysis and fuzzy KNN algorithm. We consider biological system as a set of active computational components interacting with each other and an external environment. Then we can use the network simulator to construct membrane protein interaction networks. Based on the proposed approach, we find out that the membrane protein interaction network almost has the some dynamic and collective characters, such as small-world network, topological character, and hierarchical module structure. These characters of the membrane protein interaction network will be valuable for its relatively biological and medical studies.

articleTitle: Network monitoring system design under LAN
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: This paper designed the network monitoring system in Ethernet environment, described the physical topology structure of the system running, and analyzed the system functional structure design in detail based on the overall software structure of the system. At the same time accounted for the detailed design of the database table. Through this paper, it can be seen that this system can better solve the current problems the enterprise LAN monitoring management faced.

articleTitle: The game analyses to price the target enterprise of M&A based on the perspective of real option
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: The NPV approach to price the target enterprise of M&A has already been replaced by some contemporary perspectives such as real option perspective and game perspective, etc. In this paper, the dynamic analyses to price the target enterprise of M&A will be developed under stochastic surroundings, and the equilibrium price formula will be proposed by applying the famous offer-counteroffer Rubinstein theorem which will be improved to be fit for the stochastic surroundings. The price formula will further be discussed on condition that the operating cost is less than profit flow which is assumed to follow geometric Brownian motion process. In last the simulations will show how well the proposed formulas reflect the reality.

articleTitle: About hyperstability and related properties of linear switched systems
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: This paper is devoted to the investigation of the stability and hyperstability properties of switched linear systems which posses a set of stable base configurations which are individually activated by some switching law.

articleTitle: Building and solution of intelligent control model for combustion system of industrial boiler
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: In order to achieve energy saving and environmental protection, indicators of boiler must be controlled within an appropriate range. For 35T / H boiler of a winery factory, a set of intelligent control system is designed; the control model is established and solved through an advanced genetic algorithm to realize intelligent control of the system. The application results show that the system has perfect functions, energy-saving effect obviously and environment requirements friendly.

articleTitle: Design and application of an automatic packaging machine controller based on ATmega 128
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: In this paper we investigate the major function units of an automatic F/F/S packaging machine including bag forming, material filling, sealing temperature control, status display, fault detection and alarm etc. ATmega18 microcontroller is used as the central manager to coordinate the individual control function modules. AC motor is used to fulfill the film drawing in both fixed length mode and colour tag tracing mode. Under the same precision control, it costs much less than using servo or stepper motor. This controller has the advantage of easy installation and maintenance compare to the normal implementation with a complex interface circuit.

articleTitle: Analysis about the collusion between the traffic administrative department and the franchised enterprise in the franchising operation of highway
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: This paper mainly discussed the benefit and cost on the non- productive activities between the traffic administrative department and the franchised businesses by the tool of game theory, as well as how consumers to inspect and supervise the corruption caused by such non-productive activities. On assumption that the economic man is rational and the risk is moderate, we built a tripartite game model by working out the political implications of the variable parameters in the Nash equilibrium, and then put forward some countermeasures.

articleTitle: An approach for recofnition of speech sifnal throuf h Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Speech sifnal is very unpredictable, inconsistent and produces various curves each time it is plotted. This makes speech sifnal a very challenfinf field in terms of its reception, modulation, demodulation, filterinf and processinf. So it very difficult to formulate a feneralized mathematical model for such a sifnal. However it can be shown that flexible systems like Neural Networks can be implemented to analysis such sifnals and plot out its characteristics. Besides neural network can be used to create new parameters depend on all its components and thus paved the way for a new kind of analysis.

articleTitle: Research of coordinated control system based on robust control
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: It is proposed robust control algorithm for inaccurateness of coordinated control system model. In order to improve performance of robust controller, the dynamic compensation is used for balancing the difference of dynamic between boiler side and turbine side. A loop-shaping H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> controller is designed for a boiler-turbine unit nonlinear model with adding dynamic compensation. In order to implement the complex H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> controller, a multivariable controller with PID form can be got by reducing robust controller. Simulation show that the effect of robust controller can be approached by multivariable PID controller, and the controller has better robustness and dynamic is improved after dynamic compensation.

Author Keywords: loop-shaping H∞ controller multivariable PID controller

articleTitle: An improved MRI Brain Segmentation algorithm based on AntPart
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: In this paper, a new algorithm for MRI Brain Segmentation is proposed, which is based on the AntPart algorithm [1]. This algorithm proposed partitiones the brain structure into three parts-white matter, grey matter, and cerebrospinal fluid according to the grayvalues of pixels. The main algorithm compares each pixel with the nearest class center C, all the data belonging to class C, all the data carried by one ant chosen randomly and all the data at(at most) four steps in order, and optimize the performance by recalculating the class centers, merging the close classes and reclassfying the data classified wrongly. The performances of this algorithm are compared with those of two other ones: K-means and FCM. The results show that the method proposed is more accurate.

articleTitle: The influence of skewed populations on statistical and neural network control charts for process mean
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Control charts are important tools for detecting the presence of special cause in the process and are widely used in manufacturing. It is known that neural network control charts can detect smaller shifts in the process mean better than statistical control charts. In this study, the average run length of various control charts are compared using gamma distribution generated data with various skewness to measure the robustness. From the results obtained, the neural network based control chart is found to be less robust compared to the statistical based control charts which includes Shewhart X¿ control chart, EWMA and CUSUM based control charts. Based on our results, we concluded that the EWMA control chart is the most robust.

articleTitle: Novel voice activity detection based on Cepstrum moments
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Statistical methods for voice activity detection (VAD) have shown impressive performance especially with respect to their ability to be tuned parametrically and adoptability with deferent environments. In this paper we propose a novel statistical VAD algorithm using Cepstrum coefficients and their moments as features for classification. In this method, we use moment ratio of conversation part and silent part to evaluate a threshold measure for differentiating between silent and active (Speech) parts of conversation. To make it robust in noisy environments, we will gradually tune the threshold to adopt it with dynamic background noise. Simulation results show that our proposed method has good performance in noisy environments.

articleTitle: The study of chinese dictionary mechanism based on the suboptimal search tree
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: The speed of dictionary query affects not only the speed of segmentation, but also the wide use of the segmentation system in the mass calculation. According to the different occurrence frequency of words in the text, the dictionary mechanism of the suboptimal search tree is designed so that the comparison times is reduced in the process of segmentation and the speed of segmentation is improved. Finally, the contrast experiment of the largest reverse segmentation algorithm shows that the efficiency of segmentation is improved.

articleTitle: A study on service oriented coordination for an information service platform
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: It is fundamentally important to offer efficient information services for all types of users weather the information service platform is survived and sustainable. This article adopts Petri net to describe the coordination mechanisms, and constructs three strategies to avoid conflicts among activities of service demanders by analyzing two types of service activity conflicts of information service platform. In the end, it shows we can take coordination strategies to avoid service activity conflicts by an application case of a certain technology information platform.

articleTitle: Design of the temperature control system of solar cell lamination machine
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: The temperature control is the key step in the laminating process of solar cell lamination machine. The traditional controlling method is PLC temperature control. The method being used has some shortages such as high price, low control precision, and so on. In order to improve the control precision and its performance-price ratio, a new control system taking the double microcontroller (MCU) as its core is introduced in this paper. Based upon the system, the expert PID was designed to adjust the requirements of the temperature control. The method can adjust the temperature parameters and establish an accurate laminating temperature under the condition of changing temperature and different control targets. The practical operation results show that the controller has a better robustness and a higher control precision. In addition, it can adapt to an external changing condition, and has a strong anti-jamming capability.

articleTitle: A comparison of orthogonal and overlapped relay subchannel allocation schemes for OFDMA based systems
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: This paper investigates the comparison of two different channelization schemes of relay links in the relay aided cellular network for different transmit power and the number of relays. One is the orthogonal relay subchannel allocation (ORRSA) which assigns each relay links to mobiles with orthogonal subchannels, leading to no interference between relays in the same cell. The other is the overlapped relay subchannel allocation (OVRSA) that maximizes spectral efficiency by allowing each relay to share same subchannels among them. Simulation results show that ORRSA provides slightly better cell throughput over OVRSA in multiple cell environment and both schemes of being investigated show cell throughput increases as the number of RSs per cell increases. Finally, it is observed that RS transmit power has little influence on the cell throughput performance.

articleTitle: Digital Subtract Angiography System based on ActiveMIL
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: This paper presents a high-speed medical image acquisition method of the Digital Subtract Angiography system based on ActiveMIL groupware. This system adopts two grab buffer to grab medical image based on card Matrox Meteor II/Digital and presents a algorithm for DSA Process. Finally this system realizes more DSA images process function effects.

articleTitle: Fault diagnosis for gearbox based on genetic-SVM classifier
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Failure of gearbox is very complex, so it is difficult to use the mathematical model to describe their faults. In this study, an intelligent diagnostic method based on genetic-support vector machine (GSVM) approach is presented for fault diagnosis of gearbox. The performance of the GSVM system proposed in this study is evaluated by gearbox in the wood-wool working device. The test results show that this GSVM model is effective to detect failure of gearbox in the wood-wool working device.

articleTitle: Implementation of virtual forest park interactive walkthrough system
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: The technology of three-dimensional virtual reality walkthrough has been one of the research hotspots recently. Taking the Jiufeng National Forest Park in Beijing as an example, we will discuss the process of constructing the virtual scene and the realization of the interactive walkthrough system in this paper. The essential technical problems involved in the construction of model, design of materials, environmental simulation and virtual interaction for accomplishing system are explored. The system has achieved digital reproduction and three dimension walkthrough for park's trees, ancient architecture and attractive landscapes. An approach which fits the implementation of natural scene walkthrough system is presented, which uses 3D modeling software 3ds max for scene model construction and uses on Virtools for real-time rendering and walkthrough.

articleTitle: Artificial neural network in applying multi attribute control chart for AR processes
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Quality characteristics are subject of both manufacturing and service industries, which include not only the variables but the attributes as well. In Quality Control area substantial research has been done for Auto-correlated variables; however, no attempt was done for Auto-correlated attributes. Ignoring the autocorrelation structure in constructing control charts cause the in-control run length to decrease, and the false alarms to increase as such. In this article we develop a new methodology based upon the modified Elman neural network capabilities to overcome this problem. Moreover, instead of back propagation, simulated annealing is suggested as an alternative training technique that is able to search globally and in order to generate random AR vector we develop another artificial neural network based on ARTA algorithm. We present a simulation experiments and compare the performance of the proposed methodology with the other control methods of multi-attribute processes. The result of the simulation study is encouraging.

articleTitle: Design of a blowout expert control system based on FPGA
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: The paper discusses a kind of blowout expert control system based on FPGA. It elaborates the expert control principle, and it also gives a kind of technology realization. With the help of VHDL, the paper constructs PWM generator in the Avalon's products. The paper also expounds the expert reasoning rules and the flow diagram of expert adaptive control. The experiment demonstrates that the responsibility speed is less than 0.25s, and the control performance is perfect by the condition of the simulation in the lab and the indication at the scene.

articleTitle: A novel approach to qualitative prediction
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Qualitative analysis has increasingly become a main analysis tool for handling complex dynamical systems. In qualitative analysis, Qualitative Prediction Problem is one of the central problems of qualitative modeling for a system. At present, qualitative modeling approaches cannot solve effectively this problem because they employ unsuitable manner of qualitative modeling. In this paper, by proposing the notion of ternary qualitative function as qualitative model structure for complex systems and developing a few specific constructive methods to generate such functions directly on the qualitative information available, we build a novel direct qualitative modeling approach. By applying the novel approach to an example, it is illustrated that the approach can be used to solve effectively the Qualitative Prediction Problem.

articleTitle: The generation of transport networks based on DLA model in an artificial society model with characteristics of geographical systems
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: The artificial society modeling approach for studying the behavior of complex systems has gained wide applications in recent years. The integration of this approach with geographical theories provides an inter-disciplinary approach to the study of complex human-nature interactions. By deploying widely applied RePast and Eclipse as basic tools, this study develops an artificial society model that is able to capture the characteristics of geographical systems. Consequently, DLA (diffusion limited aggregation) algorithms are applied to generate and record each agent's pathway. The simulated results demonstrate that the transportation networks produced with DLA algorithms have a spatial pattern very similar to the form of urban areas exhibited in real world.

articleTitle: Research on the data collection in chip reverse analysis
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Reverse analysis of chip is developed basing on the need of discovering design defection and eliminating hardware security vulnerability, automatic testing and diagnosis of electronic equipments. Nowadays it is the main direction of information security study as well. The data collection which is the key part of the chip reverse analysis is studied in this paper. The completeness of data collection determines whether the reverse analysis result is correct. To collecting the complete data set, a measurable sequential logic circuit model is proposed based on the external characteristics analysis of combinational and sequential logic circuit and an abstract description of data collection algorithm is given.

articleTitle: A new segment based, scale invariant, optimized boundary representain algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: This paper presents a boundary representation algorithm, the algorithm is developed for Nastaliq characters, but is it general in nature and can be used for boundary representation of any object. The basic idea is that instead of storing and computing the chain code of each pixel, segments of the object are computed by using corner points and a new B-Rep code is developed for the segments not for pixels, that code is scale invariant and much shorter than the chain code. A segment is a portion between two corner points; as the ratio between segments will remain same even when we change the scale of image, so we compute the ratio of each segment to the whole image, and finally compute optimized scale invariant code. Scale invariant code is a code that will remain identical even when we change the scale of an object means when we scale in/out, the output chain code will remain same, so it can be used in object representation and recognition.

articleTitle: Study of the use of dynamic 3D visualization graphs as supplements for understanding math
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: 3D animation representations and dynamic operations invite learners to become involved in learning ambience, and when applied to math learning, increases learners' math learning interests and calculation abilities. Therefore, this study uses computer 3D animation to visualize gradual changes in graphs as a supplement for learners to understand math operations. When applied to teaching, teachers can compare the diagram coordinates with steps of math problem solving to help students deduce the solution; they can also use learning programs to enhance students' understanding and memory by visualization. When learners successfully solve math questions, their learning motives will be activated. In the long-term, learners will have better learning motives, as well as higher learning efficiency.

articleTitle: Improvement Mpls-NOC bandwidth by dividing bandwidth in Fat-tree topology
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: We propose a combination of Fat-Tree topology and Bisection routing in MPLS network-on-chip which can increase Communication load and quality of service which is suitable for multimedia applications. We compare the performance of IP and MPLS Fat-Tree-based Network-on-chips. The simulations of the architectures are done with two-dimensional Fat-Tree topologies that used MPLS base recovery mechanism and bisection routing in source switches to provide additional bandwidth for application that need more bandwidth than a link supported bandwidth. We also carry out the high level simulation of on chip network using NS-2 to verify the analytical analysis.

articleTitle: Towards freely and correctly adjusted Dijkstra's algorithm with semantic decision tables for ontology based data matching
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Researches on ontology based data matching have been recently explored. In this paper, we will focus on how to adapt Dijkstra's algorithm for matching two data sets and how to freely adjust the parameters of Dijkstra's algorithm by the end users. A novel approach of using semantic decision tables for the adjustment will be presented and discussed. This particular approach provides a generic, user friendly, simple yet powerful solution to control an algorithm in an elegant way. In order to present the matching result, we propose a formula called GRASIM, which uses the travel cost of the shortest path, to calculate the similarities between two data sets.

articleTitle: A new quad-tree segmented image compression scheme using histogram analysis and pattern matching
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: In this paper, a new variable block-size image compression scheme is presented. A quadtree segmentation is employed to generate blocks of variable size according to their visual activity. Inactive blocks are coded by the block mean, while active blocks are coded by the proposed matching algorithm using a set of parameters associated with the pattern appearing inside the block. Both the segmentation and the pattern matching are carried out through histogram analysis of block residuals. The use of pattern parameters at the receiver together with the quadtree code reduces the cost of reconstruction significantly and exploits the efficiency of the proposed technique.

Author Keywords: quadtree decomposition, histogram analysis, block patterns

articleTitle: Optimal gain tuning of integral state feedback in electromagnetic suspension system using genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: In this paper genetic algorithm method is employed to optimal tuning of integral state feedback gains for the suspension system. For this purpose, the optimal feedback gains are determined using classical method to provide proper steady state and dynamic system performance as well as ride comfort. The genetic algorithm method is then used to modify these gains in the presence of integral controller. The electromagnetic suspension system under the proposed control method is simulated. The results prove the capability of the control in providing robust system performance against variation in load and system specifications.

articleTitle: Preferences of business process models: Interpretative analysis on spontaneously common symbols
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Through quantitative analysis, previous researched had proven a significant preference towards a specific set of notations for modeling business processes. The drawn conclusion revealed a significantly correlated coefficient preference to Norm Process Chart for using easily recognizable symbols to intuitively elicit clear understanding in representing business process models. Further interpretative analysis to qualitatively enhance these findings will only prove and strengthen the above claimed beyond reasonable doubt. The approach is to measure respondent level of accuracy in interpreting 3 different case studies modeled using 3 different modeling techniques shown to respondents in 3 different randomized sequences. The analysis includes correlating the finding against the time taken as well as respondents' level of confidence in interpreting these models. The significantly correlated results again confirmed beyond reasonable doubt Norm Process Chart being respondents ultimate choice. Further comparative analysis between results from an earlier investigation against the latter, revealed similar patterns in respondents' responses despite respondents dispersed ethnicity and educational backgrounds.

articleTitle: A new method for the cell-objects extraction of microscopic phytoplankton images
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Cell objects extraction is an important step for the phytoplankton identification. This paper presents a new method to extract the phytoplankton cell from a microscopic image with noises of impurities and sands. The method proposed analyzes the eight-direction projections of the cell's binary images to fix the cell's position and extract it. This new approach has been adopted by a phytoplankton identification system and can also be used for other systems with the same purpose.

articleTitle: An MMSE-based compressive domain interference cancellator for wideband systems
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Compressive sensing enables us to reduce the sampling rate below the Shannon Nyquist sampling rate. Unfortunately, in wideband systems, compressive sensing based signal processing often includes the undesired signals. In a previous work, ZF based method was proposed for interference cancellation. However, ZF based method do not consider the effect of noise. Moreover this method causes the degradation of desired signal. In this paper, we propose an interference cancellation method in compressive domain based on MMSE algorithm. The simulation results manifest that the proposed method improves the performance of reconstruction error rate.

articleTitle: Memory access mechanism in embedded real-time Java processor
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Currently, Java has been gradually applied in such areas as robotics, industrial control, and other embedded real-time applications owning to its advantages like platform independence, robustness, security, etc. In order to improve the performance of Java's execution engine for embedded real-time applications, an embedded real-time Java processor JPOR-32 (32-bit Java Processor Optimized for RTSJ) is designed. In this paper, the memory access mechanism of JPOR-32 is presented. In JPOR-32, the optimized memory organization structure is designed to implement the runtime data areas of the Java virtual machine (JVM). Based on it, with the preprocessing operation, the memory access instructions optimization is implemented as well. The preprocessing operation enables the JVM's runtime operations involving dynamic loading, verification, preparation, resolution, etc. to be handled in advance. It not only provides an efficient and convenient way to implement memory access, but also makes the contribution to the WCET predictability. As to the memory management, in accordance with the Real-Time Specification for Java (RTSJ), garbage collection (GC) is not allowed in the immortal memory as well as the scoped memory, and in the heap, JPOR-32 adopts improved GC scheme suitable for embedded real-time Java environment. Besides, with the architectural support of the pipelined datapath, JPOR-32 provides effective supports for efficient and predictable memory access.

articleTitle: Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles: Advanced recognition techniques for human computer interaction
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract:
Notice of Violation of IEEE Publication Principles

"Advanced Recognition Techniques for Human Computer Interaction"
by Chetan A. Burande, Raju M. Tugnayat, Nitin K. Choudhary
in the Proceedings of the 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE), February 2010, pp. 480-483

After careful and considered review of the content and authorship of this paper by a duly constituted expert committee, this paper has been found to be in violation of IEEE's Publication Principles.

This paper contains substantial duplication of text and figures from the paper cited below. The original text was copied without attribution (including appropriate references to the original author(s) and/or paper title) and without permission.

Due to the nature of this violation, reasonable effort should be made to remove all past references to this paper, and future references should be made to the following article:

"Hand Gesture Recognition for Human-Machine Interaction"
by Elena Sanchez-Nielsen (1), Luis Anton-Canalis (1), Mario Hernandez-Tejera (2)
in the Journal of WSCG, Vol 12, No. I-3, February 2003, pp. 395-402


Hand gestures are an important modality for human computer interaction (HCI). Compared to many existing interfaces, hand gestures have the advantages of being easy to use, natural, and intuitive. Successful applications of hand gesture recognition include computer games control, human-robot interaction, and sign language recognition, to name a few. Vision-based recognition systems can give computers the capability of understanding and responding to hand gestures. The aim of this technique is the proposal of a real time vision system for its application within visual interaction environments through hand gesture recognition, using general-purpose hardware and low cost sensors, like a simple personal computer and an USB web cam, so any user could make use of it in his office or home. The basis of our approach is a fast segmentation process to obtain the moving hand from the whole image, which is able to deal with a large number of hand shapes against different backgrounds and lighting conditions, and a recognition process that identifies the hand posture from the temporal sequence of segmented hands. The use of a visual memory (Stored database) allows the system to handle variations within a gesture and speed up the recognition process through the storage of different variables related to each gesture. A hierarchical gesture recognition algorithm is introduced to recognize a large number of gestures. Three stages of the proposed algorithm are based on a new hand tracking technique to recognize the actual beginning of a gesture using a Kalman filtering process, hidden Markov models and graph matching. Processing time is important in working with large databases. Therefore, special cares are taken to deal with the large number of gestures.

articleTitle: Using MPLS fault recovery mechanism and bandwidth reservation in network-on-chip
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: As CMOS technology scales down into the deep submicron (DSM) domain, devices and interconnects are subject to new types of malfunctions and failures that are harder to predict and avoid with the current system-on-chip (SoC) design methodologies. In this paper we compare four reconfigurable fault recovery mechanism and path restoration schemes, namely, Haskin, Makam, Simple Dynamic and Shortest Dynamic in real network, in the sense of on chip network design methodology. These schemes are simulated by using NS-2 that provides the advantage of reusability of entities, thus increases the NoC fault-tolerant and reliability with Quality-of-Service.

articleTitle: Simulation and application on modern Operational Research
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Operations research is an applied science, and is widely used in current scientific knowledge and mathematical methods to solve practical problems in modern management and provided the best quantitative basis for decision-makers. Optimization toolbox extends the capability of the Matlab numeric computing environment. The toolbox includes routines for many types of optimization. This article solves the problem of Operational Research in modern management by using a new software, introduces the application of optimization toolbox in simulation of modern management and gains much better effects. Optimization programs needn't be prepared and design efficiency is greatly improved. At same time, more reliable optimization algorithms are used in optimization toolbox so that the design accuracy is also greatly improved.

articleTitle: Design and analysis of portable loadless wind power source for ubiquitous sensor network
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: Nowadays, green technology solution using natural power such as solar, wind, waves et al. has been interested as an alternative power source instead of battery. This paper presents a portable power source driven by natural wind power. One of very efficient energy conversion mechanisms to change mechanical energy of natural power with electrical energy is a direct piezoelectric effect. However, this scheme requires AC stress with relative high frequency, which cannot be obtained from wind in the natural environment, because mechanical energy induced by wind shows almost constant power level. We propose a novel and simple mechanism, which converts the constant wind power to AC-like wind power using a propeller. Then, the resultant AC-like flow induces the vibration of piezoelectric cantilever, whose material is polyvinylidene fluoride (PVDF), and thereby electrical energy can be generated. Under 3.5 m/s wind speed condition (mean wind speed in city of Seoul), constant wind was converted to AC-like wind with 42.724 Hz frequency successfully and maximum output voltage from of PVDF cantilever was 4.05 V. This system, combined with processing and storage of the electrical energy, is expected to be a practical solution of wireless energy supply to ubiquitous sensor network.

articleTitle: A robust license plate detection algorithm based on multi-features
publicationTitle: 2010 The 2nd International Conference on Computer and Automation Engineering (ICCAE)
abstract: This paper presents a robust vehicle license plate detection algorithm based on multi-features, including mathematical morphology, rectangle features, edge statistics and characters features. Here we utilize the word “robust” to describe the proposed algorithm because it is not only adaptive to variance occasions, such as variance of the illumination, vehicle position, the color, both background and foreground, the acclivitous angle and the size while working in different complex environment, but also can be used in several regional license plates while some other algorithms just work well for one region and badly for another.
